known.title: Gate: isolate invite links between parallel browser tests

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - running the starter's browser suite with its configured two parallel workers.
This lookup selects the newest invite from the shared API log, regardless of which test created it. `e2e/members.spec.ts:31` uses the same lookup and also creates an invite; `playwright.config.ts:6-9` enables parallel execution with two workers. When the other flow sends its invite before this log read, this test retrieves that flow's token. Joining with `memberEmail` then fails because the token belongs to another email, intermittently failing the required live suite. Correlate each lookup with its own invite request, covering both browser flows.
